ارتشيتن (form VIII)
# اِرْتَشَيْتُنَّ (irtašaytunna) /ir.ta.ʃaj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
# اُرْتُشِيتُنَّ (urtušītunna) /ur.tu.ʃiː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
